# {k} is replaced by each declaration tail.
=== dim_mod bas
Dim {k}
=== dim_cls cls
VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1  'True
END
Attribute VB_Name = "Class1"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = False
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Dim {k}
=== static_mod bas
Static {k}
=== static_cls cls
VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1  'True
END
Attribute VB_Name = "Class1"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = False
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Static {k}
=== private_mod bas
Private {k}
=== private_cls cls
VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1  'True
END
Attribute VB_Name = "Class1"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = False
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Private {k}
=== public_mod bas
Public {k}
=== public_cls cls
VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1  'True
END
Attribute VB_Name = "Class1"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = False
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Public {k}
=== dim_proc bas
Sub P()
Dim {k}
End Sub
=== static_proc bas
Sub P()
Static {k}
End Sub
=== const_mod bas
Const {k}
=== const_proc bas
Sub P()
Const {k}
End Sub
=== type_member bas
Type T
{k}
End Type
=== redim bas
Sub P()
ReDim {k}
End Sub
=== redimpreserve bas
Sub P()
ReDim Preserve {k}
End Sub
